name: Primary operating entity
tagline: Replace with the registered business name and positioning line.
purpose: The flagship business through which most client-facing work is delivered. Visual and verbal identity should feel slightly more formal than the personal brand while remaining recognisably part of the same family.

voice.summary: Write as the organisation: clear mandates, documented reasoning, and language a busy executive can scan. The personal brand’s plainspoken honesty remains; add structure suitable for proposals, SOWs, and official comms.
voice.theyAllSoundLike: Readers should sense the same judgment and values as Andrew Riley’s personal voice, with organisation-appropriate formality and third-person or “we” as the default.
do: Define terms once, use them consistently
Sign communications with a named human when it helps trust
dont: Use stock phrases that could apply to any firm
